name: mneme-memory
description: Profile-scoped associative memory graph for agents over user and project stores.
long_description: An MCP server over the mneme memory graph. The build selects an explicit read-only, receipt-grounded, curator, or operator capability profile; both tool discovery and dispatch enforce that process-wide boundary. Tools address databases by logical name. Speaks stdio JSON-RPC as a Claude Desktop local extension. The profile, database `args`, and `author` below are filled in by build.sh.
